incidents.name: IPC sells burn the pair's balance
incidents.notes: Every IPC sell burns IPC held by the IPC/USDT pair to pump the price, so a DODO-funded loop of sells and syncs let the attacker walk the pool up and extract its USDT reserve.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xEAb0d46682Ac707A06aEFB0aC72a91a3Fd6Fe5d1 created 2024-12-31T05:17:04Z by 0x94f91f4b610fa3c112e26a742baf5602b46d6035, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x09ea8b5e546914746f3dc686ac164486a607fb7b; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). Loss measured from the exploit transaction: the attack sender nets 591,934.20 USDT of ERC-20 Transfer flow, consistent with the ~590K USDT reported.
